about: Published-evidence records on predictors of divorce, re-verified mechanically on 2026-10-20: every quote is checked verbatim against a cached copy of its source, every number in it is checked as printed, every estimate is either printed in the quote or recomputed from an explicit derivation, and every DOI is checked at Crossref. See EVIDENCE.md for the reading guide and SOURCES.md for the source list.

schema.verified: true only if all mechanical checks passed against the cached source and the DOI (if any) matched Crossref
